caveats.statement: Power values may be '*' or NULL for unknown/infinite power, so numeric comparisons must handle both.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb004 WHERE cl0143 = '*' OR cl0143 IS NULL

caveats.statement: Foil availability requires both cl0094 and cl0095 to be non-null; checking only one overcounts.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb004 WHERE cl0094 IS NOT NULL AND cl0095 IS NULL

caveats.statement: Transaction dates are stored as YYYYMM strings, so year/month filters must use string prefixes.
Country codes are ISO3 ('CZE','SVK'), not full country names.
Translation names may be NULL when no translation exists; filter cl0182 IS NOT NULL.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb008 WHERE cl0182 IS NULL

caveats.statement: Driver full name is split across cl0255 (forename) and cl0256 (surname); must concatenate to match names like 'Lewis Hamilton'
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0255, cl0256 FROM tb025 WHERE cl0256 = 'Hamilton'

caveats.statement: Race year and date are separate columns; 'since 2010' should use cl0258 not cl0261
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0258, cl0261 FROM tb027 WHERE cl0258 >= 2010 LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Circuit coordinates are split into latitude cl0244 and longitude cl0245; both needed for location
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0244, cl0245 FROM tb023 WHERE cl0241 = 'Silverstone Circuit'

caveats.statement: Expense date cl0314 is stored as string; month extraction needs substring/parsing
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0314 FROM tb041 WHERE cl0314 LIKE '2019-9%' OR cl0314 LIKE '2019-10%' LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Accident count uses cl0279 = 3 as the accident indicator; other values are not accidents
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0279, COUNT(*) FROM tb034 GROUP BY cl0279

caveats.statement: Qualifying Q1 time cl0276 may be NULL for drivers who did not participate in Q1
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb033 WHERE cl0276 IS NULL

caveats.statement: Client gender values are 'F'/'M'; other encodings may exist and should be checked
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0208, COUNT(*) FROM tb017 GROUP BY cl0208

caveats.statement: Loan amount cl0235 is also used as transaction type code in tb022; join carefully to avoid ambiguity
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0235, COUNT(*) FROM tb022 GROUP BY cl0235 LIMIT 10

caveats.statement: Event status values may be stored with different casing/spacing so 'Closed' filter can miss rows
Superhero attribute names may vary in case (Strength vs strength) causing equality filters to miss rows
